status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: Both exact cached packages passed embedded identity, offline cryptographic signature and archive-integrity checks. Their signature-aware NuGet content hashes match package metadata; the earlier raw-file hash comparison was not evidence of corruption and that inference is withdrawn. Online certificate-chain trust and revocation were not checked, and cache metadata is not an independent feed receipt. The historical reviewer restore authorization failure remains unresolved. Exact-head author CI passed Settings and Wox builds and 149 Wox tests, but reviewer-local validation and substantive review convergence remain outstanding. An isolated source-routing validation plan is being prepared, not executed.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
